title: Fourier weight as a sum of levels
statement: For every natural number $n$, every natural number $k$, and every function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, the total Fourier weight on subsets of size greater than $k$ equals the sum of the Fourier weights at levels $j$ in the interval $k+1\le j<n+1$.
